stories.title: B.C. woman who travelled to Syria to marry ISIS supporter says she realizes it was a mistake
stories.summary: That admission was in a letter Kimberly Polman wrote that's part of the agreed statement of facts filed in her case that a Vancouver judge will consider in her upcoming sentencing.

stories.title: BC Nurses’ Union says arbitration in labour dispute has ended
stories.summary: Members spent three weeks on picket lines this summer, and while some items were resolved through mediation, other compensation issues went to binding arbitration.

stories.title: 7-Eleven owners in Vernon fined $300K by WorkSafeBC
stories.summary: Documents show that employees reported multiple robberies this year alone, with coffee being thrown at them and verbal threats from customers.

stories.title: Kelowna’s Apple Bowl expansion project moves forward despite parking concerns
stories.summary: Residents urged council to reject the development permit and parking variance, which reduces the required number of parking stalls by more than half.

stories.title: Cell service concerns span South Okanagan as locals call for action
stories.summary: Dropped calls spotty data are raising concerns about whether people can reach services when they need them most, concerns brought into sharper focus by the wildfires this summer

stories.title: Up to $650K offered for 8 fugitives on Canada’s most wanted list
stories.summary: Rewards totaling up to $650,000 are being offered for information leading to the arrests of eight fugitives on Canada's most wanted list.

stories.title: Former top B.C. RCMP officer gets conditional discharge for assault on teen
stories.summary: David Teboul resigned as an RCMP assistant commissioner before pleading guilty on Oct. 28 to assaulting the 16-year-old at a lacrosse game that also involved the officer's son.

stories.title: Sixty-four B.C. Conservatives including premier-designate Doerkson take office oath
stories.summary: Political change is coming to British Columbia as members of the incoming Conservative government are being sworn into office at the legislature Thursday.

stories.title: B.C. lawsuit seeks millions in missing restaurant tips from fintech company
stories.summary: In February, members of B.C.’s hospitality industry noticed financial technology company XTM had stopped distributing money — some said they were missing thousands of dollars.
